source_quote: House Stark: known for honorable devotion to duty [loyalty is our addition]
The Rock is renowned as the wealthiest region due to its abundance of gold deposits [pride and cunning are our reading of the house's reputation]
The Targaryens conquered Westeros with dragons, wiping out houses that refused to bend the knee [traits are our reading of the house's reputation]
The Ironmen are the terror of the seas for their fierce raids; Lord Balon led a failed rebellion to free the Iron Islands [traits are our reading]
Its women are known to be clever leaders; Wikipedia: the Tyrells caused the starvation they then relieved, ensuring the positive image of House Tyrell [traits are our reading]
